one_month_reasoning: Inside the window: Q4 FY2026 results (quarter ended 2026-10-31), expected ~2026-11-23/24 ET (FY25 Q4 was reported 2025-11-24; date not yet confirmed), with the first FY2027 outlook. KEYS beat the revenue midpoint 10 of 10 quarters (median +2.4%) and EPS by a median +7.1%, so a beat on 1,930-1,950 / 3.34-3.40 is expected (ours 1,992 / 3.43; whisper 3.61). Industry prints in the past week are mixed for reactions: hyperscalers said 2027 capex rises "significantly"/"meaningfully" (Alphabet, Amazon), Advantest raised its forecast, but Teradyne fell ~7% on a flat Q4 guide despite a beat, so a strong print with a cautious, supply-governed FY27 guide could still sell off. Net: slight upward drift (median ~306, +1%) at monthly vol ~13.5% (45%/3.5 plus an earnings event), tails a little fatter than lognormal.

fair_value.method: Research target (12m) $330: 0.75 x NTM P/E 20.7x on FY2028 model EPS ~$16.2 ($335) + 0.25 x mid-cycle EPS $14.06 x 22.4x ($315), on the approved quarterly driver set.

comps_summary.our_multiple_vs_peers: KEYS NTM P/E 21.5x (303.5 / FY27 model EPS ~14.1, adjusted ex SBC like the peers) vs median 22.4x; shrink k=0.8 -> 21.7x; less 1.0x for the probability-weighted optics-cycle risk -> 20.7x on NTM (FY28) EPS at the horizon, inside the peer range.
comps_summary.premium_discount_justification: No premium argued. The 1.0x discount below the shrink rule is the long_dated_risks optics-cycle term (30% x ~-3.5x), not a persistence call. KEYS grows EPS faster (~+22% FY27, ~+14% FY28) than the AME/FTV/RAL industrial-instrument peers but carries more AI-optics cyclicality than they do and less than TER/Advantest.
comps_summary.peer_count_flag: 7 whole-company peers: listed electronic test & measurement is a short list (Rohde & Schwarz private, NI inside Emerson, Tektronix inside Ralliant, Spirent acquired). CDNS, KLAC, ONTO, FORM match <25% of revenue and are segment-only; SNPS not priced. Not padded.

thesis_break_reason: At ~$220 (-28%) the stock would be pricing ~15x on FY28 EPS of ~$14.5 or ~20x on mid-cycle EPS cut to ~$11: i.e. either the AI-optics build has rolled over (hyperscaler 2027 capex cut, transceiver digestion) or a China/export-control shock has hit, not ordinary 45%-vol noise around a $330 median.

reverse_dcf_check: 20.7x NTM P/E at the horizon (FY28 EPS ~$16.2, a 4.8% earnings yield) implies roughly 8-9% earnings growth for a decade at ~33% non-GAAP margins and ~9% cost of equity, i.e. the optics market slowing to LightCounting's ~20% by 2031 with KEYS capture still falling; plausible given the cycle risk.

sbc_treatment.note: Adjusted (non-GAAP, ex-SBC) EPS like the peers' consensus; share count falls only 1%/yr net of SBC issuance (historical diluted 179->175->173M) while buybacks of $700-850M/yr are paid out of cash in the net-debt bridge, so SBC is counted once. TTM SBC 214M (3.3% of revenue).

reasoning: Lane: industry and value chain. Demand: LightCounting sees Ethernet transceiver sales +120% in 2026 and +76% in 2027 on +50% cloud capex; Alphabet and Amazon said 2027 capex rises significantly/meaningfully (HL, 2026-10-30), Moody's ~$1trn by 2027; VIAV (closest listed competitor) says its data-center test more than doubled ex Spirent, 1.6T reaches parity with 800G in 2027 and production test is its fastest-growing line; Anritsu data-center 800GE/1.6TE orders beat plan while mobile stays flat (matches KEYS wireless +8%); Advantest raised its forecast and sees demand > supply in CY27; Lumentum is supply-constrained on 200G EMLs. Against: TER fell on a flat Q4 guide, LightCounting warns of a bumpy ride with flat/down years after 2-3 year runs, and component inflation. Model: approved quarterly driver set unchanged (FY27 revenue 8,425, FY28 9,334; non-GAAP EBIT 2,800 / 3,139); I agree with wl_capture easing because KEYS is R&D-weighted while growth shifts to production test. Valuation: NTM P/E 20.7x (7-peer median 22.4x, own 21.5x, k=0.8, minus 1.0x cycle risk) on FY28 EPS -> $335; mid-cycle cross-check $315; blend $330 (+9%). FY28 EPS ~$16.2 sits ~+13% above MarketScreener 14.37 (basis not stated) and ~+4% above an EPS built from MarketScreener EBIT 3,038 (~15.6) because the set's FY28 revenue is +4.6% above Street. Scenarios: downside $193 (China -50% plus CY28 optics digestion, margins -4pt, 15.7x), upside $443. Custom leg not driver-linked. Research used ~15 searches/fetches; several pages blocked (Teradyne Ex.99.1, semiwiki).

Wireline: KEYS does not disclose wireline dollars; Q3 FY26 prepared remarks: "Wireline revenue exceeded wireless revenue for the first time this quarter" of commercial communications $1,006M (https://s22.q4cdn.com/444849635/files/doc_earnings/2026/q3/transcript/Q3-FY2026-Prepared-Remarks.pdf); Q3 FY26 call: wireline roughly two-thirds R&D, one-third manufacturing (Motley Fool transcript 2026-08-25).
inputs_detail.derivation: Wireline quarterly estimates (flag: not disclosed): FY25 229/257/290/310 (=1,086; share of CC rising 40->47%, wireline grew double digits FY25 per Q4 FY25 remarks), FY26 358/428/520 (Q3 > wireless 486) and Q4 585 (FY26 1,891). FY growth = 1/3 x market growth (manufacturing test scales with units) + 2/3 x R&D growth (estimate +25% FY27, +15% FY28, +10% FY29; no source, the main judgment): FY27 +42.0% -> 2,685, FY28 +20.2% -> 3,228, FY29 +15.7% -> 3,734. Fiscal FY n paired with CY n (variant: test leads deployment by 2-3 quarters). Quarterly market = log-linear interpolation through each CY midpoint, rescaled so each FY sums to its CY total; forecast wireline quarters grow at one constant quarterly rate per year from the prior quarter so the FY totals hold (FY27 +5.6%/qtr, FY28 +4.2%/qtr, FY29 +3.4%/qtr), capture = wireline / market. Capture FY26 5.21% -> FY27 4.20%, FY28 3.87%, FY29 3.52%. Variant: slower R&D (+15/+10/+5%) gives CC 4,526/5,076/5,571. Supply constrains conversion for several quarters (CFO, Q3 FY26 call).

downside.story: 10th percentile: China shock (China revenue -50%, ~-8.7% of revenue; 17.5% China share, 10-K FY25) plus an optics digestion year in CY2028 (LightCounting: 2-3 year upcycles followed by flat/down years; bumpy-ride correction 2027-30 plausible): wireline capture -30%, EI -12% (FY24-style industrial/semis slip), wireless -10%, segment margins -4pt (de-leverage; FY25 was 25.9%), P/E -5x to ~15.7x as the market prices a cycle peak.

upside.story: 90th percentile: LightCounting bull case (cloud capex +70% in 2027 vs +50% base), 1.6T parity with 800G in 2027 (VIAV) and early 3.2T/CPO R&D test, component supply loosens so the 1.13 book-to-bill converts; wireline capture +25%, EI +6%, CSG margin +2pt, P/E +4x to 24.7x (top half of peers on 20%+ EPS growth).

comps_summary.our_multiple_vs_peers: KEYS NTM P/E 21.5x (303.5 / FY27 model EPS ~14.1, adjusted ex SBC like the peers) vs median 22.4x; shrink k=0.8 -> 21.7x; less 1.0x for the probability-weighted optics-cycle risk -> 20.7x on NTM (FY28) EPS at the horizon, inside the peer range.
comps_summary.premium_discount_justification: No premium argued. The 1.0x discount below the shrink rule is the long_dated_risks optics-cycle term (30% x ~-3.5x), not a persistence call. KEYS grows EPS faster (~+22% FY27, ~+14% FY28) than the AME/FTV/RAL industrial-instrument peers but carries more AI-optics cyclicality than they do and less than TER/Advantest.
comps_summary.peer_count_flag: 7 whole-company peers: listed electronic test & measurement is a short list (Rohde & Schwarz private, NI inside Emerson, Tektronix inside Ralliant, Spirent acquired). CDNS, KLAC, ONTO, FORM match <25% of revenue and are segment-only; SNPS not priced. Not padded.

model_inputs.structure_note: Value carried by the P/E (NTM at horizon = FY2028) leg on the approved quarterly driver build (weight 0.75) plus a mid-cycle-EPS x peer-median P/E cross-check custom leg (0.25, not driver-linked; weights are judgment, untested). No DCF (policy). Drivers unchanged from the approved set (wl_capture, wireless_rev, adg_rev, ei_rev, csg_margin, eisg_margin; constant mkt). Method-fit flag (thin XBRL: no revenue tag) does not weaken the P/E leg because revenue and segment income come from Ex.99.1/10-K via the gated set; the non-multiple check is the mid-cycle normalisation.
model_inputs.gap_note: Industry-lane views against the approved drivers, not in the set: (1) wl_capture falling 5.2% -> 4.2% in FY27 is reasonable (KEYS sells R&D-heavy test, 2/3 R&D; VIAV says production test is the fastest-growing part, where KEYS is weaker), so I keep it; (2) the FY28 market +30.6% is the main post-horizon exposure: LightCounting history shows 2-3 year upcycles then flat/down years, so I carry a 1.0x multiple discount rather than cut the driver. No financing event >=20%: KEYS has net cash; M&A is possible but unquantified. Q4 FY26 report date estimated ~2026-11-23/24 (FY25 reported 2025-11-24), not yet announced in my checks.
